name: Security questionnaires and vendor assessments
oneliner: Answer banks, gap identification, evidence mapping, and drafted responses for questionnaire and assessment season.
metaTitle: Security questionnaires and vendor assessments | Teclato
metaDescription: We build answer banks, identify gaps, map evidence, and draft responses for security questionnaires and vendor assessments in must-win deals.

scenarios.title: The 400-row spreadsheet
scenarios.text: Procurement forwards a vendor assessment with three tabs, four frameworks, and a due date that ignores everything else the deal needs this week.

scenarios.title: One engineer answers everything
scenarios.text: Your most senior security person spends deal-critical weeks copy-pasting last quarter's answers into this quarter's format.

scenarios.title: Answers that drift
scenarios.text: Every questionnaire gets slightly different answers. Buyers keep copies, auditors compare notes, and drift becomes a finding.

what: We build and run the machinery for security questionnaires and vendor assessments: a structured answer bank, honest gap identification, evidence mapped to every claim, and drafted responses for each new questionnaire that lands.
Your security owner reviews and approves everything. We do the assembly, the drafting, and the version control.

deliverables.name: Answer bank
deliverables.desc: Reusable, approved answers organised by control area, versioned so drift stops.

deliverables.name: Gap register
deliverables.desc: Where the honest answer is not yet yes, and the mitigation statement to use meanwhile.

deliverables.name: Evidence map
deliverables.desc: Every claim traced to the policy, report, or certificate that backs it.

deliverables.name: Drafted response
deliverables.desc: The completed questionnaire, with every uncertain row flagged for your review.

steps.title: Bring the questionnaire
steps.text: We size it on arrival: frameworks in scope, rows that are new, rows the bank already answers.
steps.need: The file and the frameworks in scope

steps.title: Build the bank
steps.text: We structure what already exists into reusable, approved answers before drafting anything new.

steps.title: Gap and evidence pass
steps.text: Honest gaps go in the register with mitigations. Every claim gets its evidence mapped.
steps.need: An hour with your security owner

steps.title: Draft
steps.text: We complete the questionnaire from the bank, flagging every row we are not certain of.
steps.need: SME answers for the flagged rows

steps.title: Approve and submit
steps.text: Your security owner signs off. The bank absorbs everything new for next time.

excludes: We do not run your security program or write your policies. We document what is true.
We do not answer yes where the truth is no. Gaps get mitigations, never cover.
We do not audit or certify anything. We are not an assessor.
We do not speak to the buyer's security team. Answers go out under your name.

shape.v: Project per questionnaire, or a standalone bank build
Days to two weeks per questionnaire

domains.name: B2B SaaS
domains.note: SIG, CAIQ, and customer-specific spreadsheets arrive with every mid-market deal. The bank pays for itself by the third one.

domains.name: BFSI
domains.note: Expect regulator-driven depth: outsourcing rules, operational resilience, and audit rights get whole sections of their own.

domains.name: Healthcare
domains.note: Data handling questions dominate, and answers must describe your actual safeguards, not your roadmap.

domains.name: IT services
domains.note: Assessments probe your delivery centres and subcontractors, because client teams inherit your controls.

related.desc: The trust story the deck tells should match the answers on file.
